decision.reason: The only evidence [ev-77235f54568b] is a one-line changelog entry: "feat(controller): enable batch event processing by default". It does not name a feature gate, flag, env var or config key, so neither the feature-gate family nor the name "batch-event-processing" is supported. The before/after literals "false"/"true" are also inferred, not stated. To decide, we need the PR #22338 diff or docs that name the setting that controls batch event processing and give its old and new defaults.
